name: Ezekiel
title: Ezekiel — Glory Departs, Glory Returns
tagline: Son of man, stand on your feet.
audience: Exiles tempted to despair or denial.
purpose: Show God’s glory, Israel’s sin, and future restoration.
christ: True Shepherd (34 → John 10); temple presence fulfilled; life to dry bones.
spirit: New spirit within (36–37); river of life.
jesus_in_this_book: True Shepherd (34 → John 10); temple presence fulfilled; life to dry bones.
watchman_charge: Warn the wicked and the righteous. Blood on hands if you stay silent.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
